executive_briefing: GW10 is defined by a massive structural shift as 40% owned João Pedro and 6.3% owned Saka are ruled out, forcing a pivot to mid-range forwards like Evanilson and Jackson. SOTA math highlights a significant 'Fear Trap' where the community is selling top-projected assets Mbeumo and B. Fernandes despite their elite xP rankings. The Haaland captaincy remains the template shield, but high-ceiling differentials in the £7m-£8m bracket offer explosive rank-climb opportunities.
